Source: The Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986 in http://cpcb.nic.in/GeneralStandards.pdf
Class and designated-use merged cells are expanded on each criterion row. Printed 1000 ml for classes B and C and 50 or less for class B are retained without repair.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs and specified 288 dpi details; no OCR
transcription.observations: First reading only. Source spelling, numbers, powers, punctuation and discrepancies retained. No distinct second inspection performed.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct child actual inspection of all exact crops, full pages and enlarged details. Parent inspected diagram and T5.1 images to resolve report findings. No OCR; not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: All 19 rows and 76 body cells compared, including repeated expansions of class/designated-use merged cells. All pH/DO/BOD/coliform values, inequalities, free-ammonia units and E-class thresholds match. Preserve class A Total Coliform MPN / 100 ml = 50 or less; B MPN / 1000 ml = 50 or less; C MPN / 1000 ml = 5000 or less. No conventional-limit correction warranted. Class D pH 6.5 to 8.5, DO 4 or more, Free Ammonia 1.2 mg/l or less. E pH 6.0 to 8.5, conductivity micro mhos/cm < 2250, Sodium Absorption Ratio (SAR) < 26, Boron < 2 mg/l. mg/l default and source credit retained. Report observations are bound to this corrected record: stale draft blocker removed; chemical-product context and LaTeX labels added where reported.
